component.name: OpenTranscribe Setup
Configuration d'OpenTranscribe
component.summary: Connect a speech-to-text provider to your local assistant
Connecter un fournisseur de transcription à votre assistant local

description.p: OpenTranscribe Setup configures the OpenTranscribe transcription engine and connects it to a local MCP client. It stores provider credentials in your session keyring, registers the packaged engine with your assistant, and diagnoses the connection.

Audio is sent to the transcription provider you choose. The transcript is returned to your assistant, whose own provider may process it in turn. No transcript history is kept by default, and no OpenTranscribe account is required.

La Configuration d'OpenTranscribe paramètre le moteur de transcription OpenTranscribe et le relie à un client MCP local. Elle enregistre les clés de fournisseur dans le trousseau de votre session, déclare le moteur fourni auprès de votre assistant et diagnostique la connexion.
First Linux desktop distribution of OpenTranscribe Setup.
